_principle: Michael, 2026-10-02: do not rely solely on Wikipedia. Audioura's value is finding facts in many, including little-known, sources and VERIFYING them against high-reliability ones. The A/B therefore rewards discovery: a fact from a less-known source that is corroborated by a high-reliability source counts MORE than a Wikipedia-only fact, and the answer key itself draws on newspapers and official sites, not only Wikipedia.

_reliability_tiers.high: official site of the place or its operator; museums, museum associations, historical societies, archives, government (.gov) and universities (.edu); established newspapers and magazines (Boston Globe, NYT, Le Monde, Monaco Hebdo); Wikipedia and Wikidata
_reliability_tiers.medium: established travel and dining guides with editors (Michelin, Eater, Boston Magazine, Atlas Obscura)
_reliability_tiers.discovery: blogs, local forums, review sites, niche or community history pages: valuable for leads, but a fact from here counts only once corroborated by a high tier source
_reliability_tiers.never_alone: AI-generated pages, content farms, SEO listicles
